AO No. 185 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Naresh Pant, learned counsel for the
appellant.
2. None is present for the respondent.
3. Heard.
4. Admit.
5. List this matter on 13.11.2025.
6. Meanwhile, Lower Court Record may also 
be summoned.
7. Also heard on the Stay Application (IA 
No. 2 of 2024).
8. Learned counsel for the appellant 
submits that execution of proceedings is going 
on and he further submits that the entire 
awarded amount, excluding the statutory 
deposit, has been submitted with the 
concerned court.
9. Having considered the submission of 
learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed 
that since the appellant has deposited the 
entire awarded amount with the concerned 
court, the effect and operation of the 
impugned judgment and award dated 
21.10.2023 passed by Motor Accident Claim 
Tribunal, Khatima, District Udham Singh 
Nagar in M.A.C.P. No. 157 of 2022 shall 
remain stayed. (Stay application is disposed 
of).

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
AO No.185 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Raunak Pant, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mr. Naresh Pant, learned
counsel for the appellant. 
2. Mr. Tajhar Qayyum, learned counsel 
for respondent Nos.1 & 2/claimants. 
3. Recall Application (IA No. 5 of 2025) 
has been filed by the appellant seeking 
recall/modification of the order dated 
29.08.2025, to the extent it directs the 
appellant to deposit the entire awarded 
amount before the concerned Tribunal, 
excluding the statutory amount.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant 
submits that in paragraph no.9 of the order 
dated 29.08.2025, it has been recorded that 
the appellant has deposited the entire 
awarded amount with the concerned Court; 
however, the correct position is that the 
appellant had undertaken to deposit the 
awarded amount within stipulated period 
before the concerned Court.
5. Considering the submissions and to 
correct the inadvertent error, the recall 
application is allowed. Accordingly, the order 
dated 29.08.2025 is modified to the extent 
that the appellant shall deposit the entire 
awarded amount before the concerned 
Court within a period of two weeks from 
today.
6. List this case on the date already 
fixed, i.e., 13.11.2025.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 
 15.10.2025

AO No. 185 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Raunak Pant, learned counsel, 
holding brief of Mr. Naresh Pant, learned 
counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. Mehboob Rahi, learned counsel for 
the respondents.
3. Learned counsel for the respondents 
submits that respondent no. 2 has died and 
since her husband/legal heir is already party 
to this appeal as respondent no. 1, therefore, 
there is no need for substitution.
4. Appellant is directed to file amended 
memo of appeal within a week.
5. Appellant shall file amended memo of 
parties for adding the word ‘deceased’ against 
respondent no. 2.
6. Since, Money Withdrawal Application No. 
6 of 2025 have been filed on behalf of 
respondent nos. 1 and 2 and for the fact that 
respondent no. 2 has died, therefore, learned 
counsel for the respondents submits that he 
does not want to press the money withdrawal 
application. Accordingly, the Money 
Withdrawal Application is dismissed as 
withdrawn.
7. List this matter in due course.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 19.12.2025
Ujjwal
